title: Ongoing result sentinel was interpreted as truthy terminal state
impact: The first smoke skipped required selection and did not prove a terminal lifecycle.
containment: Selection is now gated only by result == -1 and terminal results are checked first.
corrective_action: Drive the native smoke until declared terminal result 0, 1 or 2.
regression_test: Seven unit tests pass; native smoke made 15 selections, observed stale terminal selection data, made zero post-terminal selections and ended with result 0.
